lead.headline: Ahead after Thursday; Pickens questionable on the bench
lead.deck: Wilson OUT, Pickens and Ferguson questionable — both of his on the bench; every Sunday starter clear.
lead.body: The bad news first, and it stays on the bench: Garrett Wilson is out with the concussion, and Dallas listed George Pickens questionable with the hamstring on Friday, alongside tight end Jake Ferguson. Neither Pickens nor Wilson starts here. Every Sunday starter is clear: Rashee Rice practised fully Thursday and Friday, Jonathan Taylor came off the Colts' report with Shane Steichen saying his workload will not change despite the trade talk, and Green Bay listed MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks questionable, which only firms up Josh Jacobs' carries. Jayden Daniels practised fully all week. Bloodsports lead Jackrabbits 18.9 to 10.88 and ESPN gives a 61% chance. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to do.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to set
doFirst.deck: The lineup is the projection lineup and no starter is in doubt.
doFirst.note: Free agents are open; nothing on the wire beats a starter, and Aubrey — now a free agent — is a point, not a gap.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to decide before Sunday: Friday left every starter clear, and Pickens' questionable tag is on the bench.
